stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that helping monarchs requires a large amount of effort?

options.label: A
options.text: This yearly migration is one of the most impressive in the animal kingdom, but its future is uncertain. (paragraph 4)

options.label: B
options.text: Over the past 60 years, thousands of people have helped scientists study these incredible insects. (paragraph 9)

options.label: C
options.text: But a butterfly scientist named Fred Urquhart had a plan. (paragraph 10)
